text:
jules (growth): Quick sync for next week's mock launch webinar — need owners for reg page fields, Zoom preflight, backup capture, and post-event tagging. Can we lock owners now?

ria (events): Ill run Zoom + pre-show. Plan: waiting room T-20, alt hosts set, cloud recording + auto-transcript. Disable file transfer and set chat to host-only during broadcast.

tom (producer): Ill do capture. Local SSD backup + immediate S3 push script. Request: provide RTMP fallback endpoint and stream key in 1Password. Naming: `launch_{YYYYMMDD}_{region}_{role}.{ext}`.

kai (product): Ill publish reg template. Fields: first, last, email, company, role, country, recording_consent (yes/no), one-line use case. Hidden UTMs + timezone. Add dropdown: publish_pref (public/internal/no).

jules (growth): HubSpot mapping: campaign=mock-launch, source=webinar, map publish_pref to `webinar_publish_pref`. Zap should tag by country and add to nurture list.

ria (events): Ops checklist Ill pin: 1) Reg page up + test registrant, 2) Meeting created + alt hosts, 3) Producer backup confirmed, 4) Zap -> HubSpot test, 5) Pre-show run T-20.

tom (producer): Accessibility: Ill output .vtt captions + plain-text transcript and a 30s social teaser. Will upload raw within 4h and teaser within 24h.

jules (growth): Email flow: Day0 thank-you + cal invite, Day2 2-min highlights + CTA, Day7 full replay + transcript (respecting publish_pref). Kai/1Password for keys?

kai (product): Got it. Sending RTMP credentials to 1Password now. Also adding a consent checkbox that flags contacts for exclusion from public assets.

zapier-bot: Zap created: push registrants -> HubSpot contact list "webinar-mock-launch" with mapping JSON posted in #infra-integrations.

jules (growth): Great — locking owners. If any sensitive customer content appears, flag in thread before publish. Thanks all :tada:
